fields.label: Target DocType
fields.help: DocType для якого буде застосовуватися це правило

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Rules are tried from the highest priority; the first one that matches assigns (and none does while its assignment is open)

fields.label: Days of the week
fields.options:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday
fields.description: Assign only on these days (site time zone); empty - every day

fields.label: Unassign when (JSON)
fields.description: When the document matches, the open assignment of this rule is cancelled - e.g. {"status": "Cancelled"}

fields.label: Close when (JSON)
fields.description: When the document matches, the open assignment of this rule is closed as done - e.g. {"status": "Answered"}

fields.label: Assign
fields.options:
Everyone
Round Robin
Load Balancing
Based on Field
fields.description: Everyone - every user below; Round Robin - one by one in turn; Load Balancing - the one with the fewest open assignments; Based on Field - the user in a field of the document

fields.label: User field
fields.description: Fieldname of a Link to User on the document

fields.label: Users
fields.description: Who is assigned; empty - the holders of the role below (within their role scope)

fields.label: Assign to Role
fields.help: Holders of this role (within their scope), when the user list is empty

fields.label: Assign to User
fields.help: One user (older rules; the user list replaces it)

fields.label: Due date from
fields.description: Fieldname of a Date on the document - the assignment's due date

fields.label: Last assigned
fields.description: Round robin: whose turn was last
